title: Requirements Backlog
summary: Consolidated requirements backlog: completed v1.0 requirement areas plus post-v1.0 remaining work with priorities, refreshed 2026-08-29.
notes: No frontmatter and path is docs/development/, so no filename convention signal. Content is a consolidated requirement set with feature items, descriptions and Priority columns, plus status markers (Done, Done (plumbing)) -> PRD over DOC. Some entries name implementation files (service/signed_mail.rs, application/saved_searches.rs, installer/), which is a weak SPEC signal, but they are status pointers rather than contracts or schemas, so PRD wins. Refreshed 2026-08-29: ten previously-outstanding items now marked Done (saved search/virtual folders, color-coded tags, virtual scrolling, Windows installer, theme customization, Microsoft Graph API, calendar integration; CalDAV and S/MIME signature checking partially built, PGP still detection only).
